geodata_geodataflagqueue.no_open_flags_r: Ayikho ifulegi evulekile. Qhuba ukuhlola ukuze uhlole kabusha idatha engeniswe.
geodata_geodataflagqueue.showing_the_mos: Kukhonjiswe amafulegi {length} abucayi kakhulu kwama-{flagsTotal} {statusFilter} — hlela ngokwemizimba, noma uqede uhlu bese uvuselela.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.accept_this_f: Amukela le fulegi njengoba injalo: isimo sihlala kudatha, siqashwe njengokubuyekezwa nokwamukeleka. Azikho izimuayizimu ezishintshayo.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.cascade_also_: Cascade — susa nazo zonke izigaba ezingaphansi kwayo. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, ukususa imuayizimu esenabantwana kuyenqeleka.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.collapse_a_si: Collapse a single-child chain of same-space rows. Ilungu eliphezulu lihlala; abantwana balabo abaphansi bayiswa kulo, kanti amalungu aphansi ayasulwa kancane (aqashwe, angabuyiselwa).
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.create_a_new_: Dala indawo yegunya ephakathi entsha ngaphansi komzali — isimo sayo yinyunyana yabantwana abalelwe, isibalo sabo yisixhumano sabo — bese ubuyisela abantwana kuyo.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.move_a_jurisd: Thutha indawo yegunya ngaphansi komzali ohlukile. Ukuthutha kuqashwe njengokulungiswa ngesandla futhi kungabuyiselwa.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.replace_the_s: Thayeda isibalo sabantu esigcinwe. Inani langaphambilini liqashwe ukuze ukulungiswa kungabuyiselwa.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.soft_delete_t: Susa kancane le ndawo yegunya. Yonke imuayizimu esuswe iqashwe, ukuze ukususa kungabuyiselwa.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.sum_of_live_c: Isixhumano sabantwana abaphilayo. Sihlanganisa izibalo zabantwana abaqondile.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.worldpop_rast: Isibalo se-WorldPop raster. Sihlanganisa i-raster yesibalo sabantu sezwe (isibalo se-ISO sonke).
